constraints: Use generated ordinary prime-order curves and synthetic targets only.
Disclose that seeded field primes are constrained to p mod 4 = 3 for deterministic square roots.
Require subgroup order q to increase strictly with the size schedule for each seed.
Charge factor-base construction, compilation, storage, online queries, failed targets, and memory traffic separately.
Treat all results as TOY-EVIDENCE and prohibit deployment or faster-than-rho claims.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether a coordinate-defined set preserves near-random exact m-fold expansion while reducing a functional-advice-byte split-compiler S*T^2/(epsilon*q) diagnostic enough to justify a source-tagged implementation.
research_question.motivation: The first coordinate-energy experiment showed that pair concentration alone can collapse target coverage and that both ordered-tuple and ordinary multiset occupancy miss finite sign-complete cancellation classes; exact signed support is therefore primary.

methods: exact signed additive support with unordered occupancy as a sizing control

research_question.title: Recursive expansion-compression frontier for coordinate factor bases
